blind.description: A vertical stack of five hardcover books piled on top of each other. The bindings feature rich reddish-brown and dark green covers with gold-accented spines, enclosing yellowish-cream text blocks. The books are stacked stably, with the top books rotated slightly off-axis for a natural look. Surfaces are clean, solid, and flat on the floor without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: A reddish-brown rectangular book cover angled slightly over the rectangular silhouettes and page edges of the books underneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/6 of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height (about 10 to 12 inches tall) and under 1 foot wide.
